method: Every NT chapter has one 5-question source-extractive chapter quiz. Correct answers are exact excerpts from the local Luther 1912 chapter; distractors are exact excerpts from other chapters/books. Existing 260 curated questions are preserved.
note: The new 1,300 chapter questions are automatically text-verified/source-extractive, not manually editorially reviewed. Existing curated questions retain their prior status.
